pattern.description: A hand cursor clicks the red stop button on the presenter bubble; the button collapses, the cursor exits, and a shared-video page assembles: the player card scales up from behind while the camera bubble shrinks into its lower-right corner, then the byline fades in and the title starts typing.
pattern.why_premium: One click causes the whole state change (record to shareable video) with no cut, demonstrating the product's core promise; the presenter bubble persists across states as the anchor, and the title typewriter keeps the eye moving after the main motion settles.

build_hint.remotion: Stop button: interpolate(frame,[0,6],[1,0]) on scale/opacity after click frame. Player card: spring({frame:frame-6, fps, config:{damping:24, stiffness:150}}) mapped to opacity, scale 0.85→1 and translateY 30→0. Camera bubble: same spring driving interpolate to corner x/y and scale 1→0.7. Byline: interpolate opacity over 9 frames starting ~frame 20. Title: slice the string by Math.floor(interpolate(frame,[24,60],[0,len])) for typewriter.

notes: Camera summary reports move=none with scale 0.56, i.e. the scene effectively zooms out as the UI page appears; sphere motion is partly that. Manual boxes for the stop button and cursor are approximations since both leave the frame. The title is mid-typing at the end frame ('Wi'); the full title is likely in a later event.
